title.raw: 卷5 高宗紀 Volume 5 Annals: Gaozong (Emperor Wencheng)

sentences.zh: 高宗文成皇帝，諱濬，恭宗景穆皇帝之長子也。

translations.literal: Gaozong, Emperor Wencheng, bore the taboo name Jun; he was Gongzong, Emperor Jingmu's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong, Emperor Wencheng, bore the taboo name Jun. He was the eldest son of Gongzong, Emperor Jingmu.

sentences.zh: 母曰閭氏，真君元年六月生於東宮。

translations.literal: His mother was the Lu clan; in the sixth month of the first year of Zhenjun he was born in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was of the Lu clan. In the sixth month of the first year of Zhenjun he was born in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 帝少聰達，世祖愛之，常置左右，號世嫡皇孫。

translations.literal: The Emperor in youth was quick and penetrating; Shizu loved him, constantly kept him at his side, and styled him Heir of the World, Imperial Grandson.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he was quick and penetrating. Shizu loved him, kept him constantly at his side, and styled him Heir of the World, Imperial Grandson.

sentences.zh: 年五歲，世祖北巡，帝從在後，逢虜帥桎一奴欲加其罰。

translations.literal: At age five, when Shizu toured the north, the Emperor followed behind; they met a barbarian commander fettering a slave and about to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: At the age of five, when Shizu toured the north, the boy followed behind. They met a barbarian commander who had bound a slave and was about to punish him.

sentences.zh: 帝謂之曰：「奴今遭我，汝宜釋之。

translations.literal: The Emperor said to him: "This slave has now met me—you ought to release him.
translations.idiomatic: The boy said to him, "This slave has met me now—you should release him.

sentences.zh: 」帥奉命解縛。

translations.literal: " The commander obeyed the command and undid the bonds.
translations.idiomatic: " The commander obeyed and untied him.

sentences.zh: 世祖聞之，曰：「此兒雖小，欲以天子自處。

translations.literal: Shizu heard of it and said: "Though this child is small, he wishes to comport himself as Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizu heard of it he said, "Though this child is small, he means to comport himself as Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 」意奇之。

translations.literal: " He regarded it as extraordinary.
translations.idiomatic: " He marveled at it.

sentences.zh: 既長，風格異常，每有大政，常參決可否。

translations.literal: When he had grown, his bearing was unusual; whenever there was great policy he often joined in deciding yes or no.
translations.idiomatic: When he had grown, his bearing was unusual. Whenever major policy was at stake he often took part in deciding it.

sentences.zh: 正平二年十月戊申，即皇帝位於永安前殿，大赦，改年。

translations.literal: Tenth month of the second year of Zhengping, day wushen: he assumed the imperial throne in the front hall of Yong'an; a general amnesty; the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the second year of Zhengping, on the wushen day, he took the throne in the front hall of Yong'an, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 興安元年冬十月，以驃騎大將軍元壽樂為太宰、都督中外諸軍事、錄尚書事；

translations.literal: Tenth month of the first year of Xing'an: General of Agile Cavalry Yuan Shoule was made Grand Preceptor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies Within and Without, and Recorder of Secretariat Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Xing'an, General of Agile Cavalry Yuan Shoule was made Grand Preceptor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies Within and Without, and Recorder of Secretariat Affairs;

sentences.zh: 尚書長孫渴侯為尚書令，加儀同三司。

translations.literal: Changsun Kehou of the Secretariat was made Director of the Secretariat, with added Three-Director Equipage.
translations.idiomatic: Changsun Kehou of the Secretariat was made Director of the Secretariat, with the added rank of Three-Director Equipage.

sentences.zh: 十有一月丙子，二人爭權，並賜死。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: the two contended for power and were both ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingzi day, the two contended for power and were both ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 癸未，廣陽王建薨，臨淮王譚薨。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Prince of Guangyang Jian died; Prince of Huai'nan Tan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Prince of Guangyang Jian died, and Prince of Huai'nan Tan died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，皇妣薨。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the imperial mother died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day the imperial mother died.

sentences.zh: 太尉張黎、司徒古弼，以議不合旨，黜為外都大官。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Zhang Li and Minister of Works Gu Bi, because their counsel did not accord with the imperial will, were demoted to Outer Metropolitan Officials.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Zhang Li and Minister of Works Gu Bi, because their counsel did not accord with the imperial will, were demoted to Outer Metropolitan Officials.

sentences.zh: 平南將軍宋子侯周忸進爵樂陵王，南部尚書、章安子陸麗為平原王，文武各加位一等。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the South, Marquis of Songzi Zhou Niu, was advanced in rank to Prince of Leling; Minister of the South, Viscount of Zhang'an Lu Li, was made Prince of Pingyuan; civil and military officials each received one step in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Niu, General Who Pacifies the South and Marquis of Songzi, was advanced to Prince of Leling; Lu Li, Minister of the South and Viscount of Zhang'an, was made Prince of Pingyuan; civil and military officials each rose one rank.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，追尊景穆太子為景穆皇帝，皇妣為恭皇后；

translations.literal: Day renyin: posthumously honored Crown Prince Jingmu as Emperor Jingmu and the imperial mother as Empress Gong;
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day Crown Prince Jingmu was posthumously honored as Emperor Jingmu and the imperial mother as Empress Gong;

sentences.zh: 尊保母常氏為保太后。

translations.literal: the wet-nurse, the Chang clan, was honored as Empress Dowager Protector.
translations.idiomatic: the wet-nurse of the Chang clan was honored as Empress Dowager Protector.

sentences.zh: 隴西屠各王景文叛，詔統萬鎮將、南陽王惠壽討平之。

translations.literal: Jingwen, king of the Tuge in Longxi, rebelled; an edict ordered the commander of Tongwan garrison, Prince of Nanyang Huishou, to suppress and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: Jingwen, king of the Tuge in Longxi, rebelled. An edict ordered Prince of Nanyang Huishou, commander of Tongwan garrison, to suppress and pacify him.

sentences.zh: 十有二月戊申，祔葬恭皇后於金陵。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wushen: associated burial of Empress Gong at Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wushen day, Empress Gong was associated in burial at Jinling.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，初復佛法。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Buddhism was first restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day the Buddhist faith was restored for the first time.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以樂陵王周忸為太尉，平原王陸麗為司徒，鎮西將軍杜元寶為司空。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Prince of Leling Zhou Niu was made Grand Commandant; Prince of Pingyuan Lu Li was made Minister of Works; General Who Guards the West Du Yuanbao was made Minister of the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day Prince of Leling Zhou Niu was made Grand Commandant, Prince of Pingyuan Lu Li Minister of Works, and General Who Guards the West Du Yuanbao Minister of the Masses.

sentences.zh: 保達、沙獵國各遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Baoda and the state of Shalie each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Baoda and the state of Shalie each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，建業公陸俟進爵東平王，廣平公杜遺進爵為王。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Duke of Jianye Lu Hou was advanced to Prince of Dongping; Duke of Guangping Du Yi was advanced to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day Duke of Jianye Lu Hou was advanced to Prince of Dongping and Duke of Guangping Du Yi was advanced to prince.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔以營州蝗，開倉賑恤。

translations.literal: Day guihai: an edict, because of locusts in Yingzhou, ordered granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, because of locusts in Yingzhou, an edict ordered granaries opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太尉、樂陵王周忸有罪，賜死。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Grand Commandant, Prince of Leling Zhou Niu, was guilty and ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Grand Commandant Zhou Niu, Prince of Leling, was found guilty and ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 濮陽公閭若文進爵為王。

translations.literal: Duke of Puyang Lu Ruowen was advanced to prince.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Puyang Lu Ruowen was advanced to prince.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛巳，司空杜元寶進爵京兆王。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day xinsi: Minister of the Masses Du Yuanbao was advanced to Prince of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the xinsi day, Minister of the Masses Du Yuanbao was advanced to Prince of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 廣平王杜遺薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Guangping Du Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Guangping Du Yi died.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射、東安公劉尼進爵為王。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat, Duke of Dong'an Liu Ni, was advanced to prince.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ni, Vice Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Dong'an, was advanced to prince.

sentences.zh: 封建寧王崇子麗為濟南王。

translations.literal: Li, son of Prince of Jianning Chong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Li, son of Prince of Jianning Chong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔與民雜調十五。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: an edict imposed miscellaneous levies on the people of fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day an edict imposed miscellaneous levies on the people of fifteen.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，尚書、西平公源賀進爵為王。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Director of the Secretariat, Duke of Xiping Yuan He, was advanced to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Yuan He, Director of the Secretariat and Duke of Xiping, was advanced to prince.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，司空、京兆王杜元寶謀反，伏誅；

translations.literal: Second month, day jiwei: Minister of the Masses, Prince of Jingzhao Du Yuanbao, plotted rebellion and was executed;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiwei day, Minister of the Masses Du Yuanbao, Prince of Jingzhao, plotted rebellion and was executed;

sentences.zh: 建寧王崇、崇子濟南王麗為元寶所引，各賜死。

translations.literal: Prince of Jianning Chong and Chong's son Prince of Jinan Li, implicated by Yuanbao, were each ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jianning Chong and his son Li, Prince of Jinan, implicated by Yuanbao, were each ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，發京師五千人穿天淵池。

translations.literal: Day yichou: five thousand men from the capital were sent to dig the Tianyuan Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day five thousand men from the capital were sent to dig the Tianyuan Pool.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉義隆子劭殺其父而自立。

translations.literal: That month Liu Yilong's son Shao killed his father and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Yilong's son Shao killed his father and seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，尊保太后為皇太后。

translations.literal: Third month, day renwu: Empress Dowager Protector was honored as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renwu day, the Empress Dowager Protector was honored as Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 安豐公閭虎皮進爵為河間王。

translations.literal: Duke of Anfeng Lu Hupi was advanced to Prince of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Anfeng Lu Hupi was advanced to Prince of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 乙未，疏勒國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the state of Shule sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day the state of Shule sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙酉，行幸崞山。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day yiyou: the imperial carriage traveled to Mount Guo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the yiyou day, the emperor went to Mount Guo.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，還宮。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉劭弟駿殺劭而自立。

translations.literal: That month Liu Shao's younger brother Jun killed Shao and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Shao's younger brother Liu Jun killed Shao and seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥，太皇太后赫連氏崩。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yihai: Grand Empress Dowager Helian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the yihai day, Grand Empress Dowager Helian died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinhai: the imperial carriage traveled to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinhai day, the emperor went to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 濮陽王閭若文，征西大將軍、永昌王仁謀反。

translations.literal: Prince of Puyang Lu Ruowen and General Who Conquers the West, Prince of Yongchang Ren, plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Puyang Lu Ruowen and Ren, General Who Conquers the West and Prince of Yongchang, plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜仁死於長安，若文伏誅。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Ren was ordered to die at Chang'an; Ruowen was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Ren was ordered to die at Chang'an; Ruowen was executed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day jisi: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是月，築馬射臺於南郊。

translations.literal: That month a horse-shooting terrace was built at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: That month a horse-shooting terrace was built at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，渴槃陁國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinwei: the state of Kapisa sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinwei day, the state of Kapisa sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔曰：「朕以眇身，纂承大業，懼不能宣慈惠和，寧濟萬宇，夙夜兢兢，若臨淵谷。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: an edict said: "We, in our slight person, have succeeded to the great enterprise, fearing we cannot spread kindness, harmony, and peace, and settle the myriad realms—day and night we are cautious, as if facing a deep ravine.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day an edict said, "We, in our slight person, have succeeded to the great enterprise and fear we cannot spread kindness, harmony, and peace to settle the myriad realms. Day and night we are cautious, as if facing a deep ravine.

sentences.zh: 然即位以來，百姓晏安，風雨順序，邊方無事，眾瑞兼呈，不可稱數。

translations.literal: Yet since assuming the throne the common people are at ease, wind and rain are in order, the borders are without incident, and many auspices together appear beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Yet since assuming the throne the people are at ease, wind and rain are in order, the borders are quiet, and auspicious signs have appeared beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 又於苑內獲方寸玉印，其文曰『子孫長壽』，羣公卿士咸曰『休哉』！

translations.literal: Moreover within the park a square-inch jade seal was obtained, its inscription reading 'Long life for sons and grandsons'; the assembled dukes, ministers, and scholars all said 'How excellent!'
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, within the park a square-inch jade seal was found inscribed 'Long life for sons and grandsons,' and the assembled dukes, ministers, and scholars all cried, 'How excellent!'

sentences.zh: 豈朕一人克臻斯應，實由天地祖宗降祐之所致也。

translations.literal: How could We alone attain such a response—it is truly because Heaven, Earth, and the ancestors bestowed blessing.
translations.idiomatic: How could we alone attain such a response? It is truly because Heaven, Earth, and the ancestors bestowed their blessing.

sentences.zh: 思與兆庶共茲嘉慶，其令民大酺三日，諸殊死已下各降罪一等。

translations.literal: We think to share this fine celebration with the myriad people: let the people feast for three days; all below extraordinary death each have crimes reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: We wish to share this fine celebration with the myriad people: let the people feast for three days, and let all below extraordinary death have their crimes reduced one degree.

sentences.zh: 」九月壬子，閱武於南郊。

translations.literal: " Ninth month, day renzi: reviewed arms at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month, on the renzi day, arms were reviewed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月辛酉，行幸信都、中山，觀察風俗。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day xinyou: traveled to Xinzhou and Zhongshan to observe local customs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the xinyou day, the emperor went to Xinzhou and Zhongshan to observe local customs.

sentences.zh: 十有二月，誅河間鄚民為賊盜者，男年十五以下為生口，班賜從臣各有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: bandits among the people of Hejian and Mo were executed; males fifteen and under were taken as living booty and distributed to followers, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month bandits among the people of Hejian and Mo were executed; males fifteen and under were taken as living booty and distributed to followers according to rank.

sentences.zh: 甲午，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庫莫奚、契丹、罽賓等十餘國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Kumo Xi, Khitan, Kapisa, and more than ten other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Kumo Xi, Khitan, Kapisa, and more than ten other states each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 復北平公長孫敦王爵。

translations.literal: Duke of Beiping Changsun Dun's princely rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Beiping Changsun Dun's princely rank was restored.

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 興光元年春正月乙丑，以侍中河南公伊馛為司空。

translations.literal: First year of Xingguang, spring, first month, day yichou: Palace Attendant, Duke of Henan Yi Ba, was made Minister of the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the first year of Xingguang, on the yichou day, Palace Attendant Yi Ba, Duke of Henan, was made Minister of the Masses.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，帝至道壇，登受圖籙；

translations.literal: Second month, day jiawu: the Emperor came to the Dao altar and ascended to receive the registers and tallies;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiawu day, the emperor came to the Dao altar and ascended to receive the registers and tallies;

sentences.zh: 禮畢，曲赦京師，班賞各有差。

translations.literal: when the rites were complete, a partial amnesty in the capital and distributions of rewards, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: when the rites were complete there was a partial amnesty in the capital and rewards were distributed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 夏六月丙寅，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, day bingyin: the imperial carriage traveled to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on the bingyin day, the emperor went to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，皇子弘生。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengzi: the imperial son Hong was born.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengzi day, the imperial son Hong was born.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大赦，改年。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: a general amnesty; the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day there was a general amnesty and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，趙王深薨。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: Prince of Zhao Shen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiaxu day, Prince of Zhao Shen died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇叔虎頭、龍頭薨。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the imperial uncles Hutou and Longtou died.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day the imperial uncles Hutou and Longtou died.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，庫莫奚國獻名馬，有一角，狀如麟。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengshen: the state of Kumo Xi presented a famous horse with one horn, shaped like a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengshen day, the state of Kumo Xi presented a famous horse with one horn, shaped like a qilin.

sentences.zh: 是月，閉都城門，大索三日，獲姦人亡命數百人。

translations.literal: That month the capital gates were closed and a great search lasted three days; several hundred adulterers and fugitives were seized.
translations.idiomatic: That month the capital gates were closed and a great search lasted three days; several hundred adulterers and fugitives were seized.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月，北鎮將房杖擊蠕蠕，虜其將豆渾與句等，獲馬千餘匹。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month: the northern garrison general Fang Zhang attacked the Rouran, captured their generals Douhun and Gou and others, and obtained more than a thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter the northern garrison general Fang Zhang attacked the Rouran, captured their generals Douhun, Gou, and others, and took more than a thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，行幸中山，遂幸信都。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: the imperial carriage traveled to Zhongshan, then to Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the emperor went to Zhongshan, then to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 十有二月丙子，還幸靈丘，至溫泉宮。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingzi: returned to Lingqiu, reaching the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingzi day, he returned to Lingqiu and reached the Hot Springs Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 出于、叱萬單國各遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: The states of Chuyu and Chiwandan each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The states of Chuyu and Chiwandan each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 太安元年春正月辛酉，奉世祖、恭宗神主于太廟。

translations.literal: First year of Tai'an, spring, first month, day xinyou: the spirit tablets of Shizu and Gongzong were installed in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the first year of Tai'an, on the xinyou day, the spirit tablets of Shizu and Gongzong were installed in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 車騎大將軍、樂平王拔有罪，賜死。

translations.literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry, Prince of Yueping Ba, was guilty and ordered to die.
translations.idiomatic: Ba, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Prince of Yueping, was found guilty and ordered to die.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，武昌王提薨。

translations.idiomatic: If one is truly pure and capable and praised by all, yet lodges a false complaint to seek justice, the crime is reversed upon him.

translations.idiomatic: If an envoy accepts bribes and judgment is not fair, they may appeal to the Imperial Chariot Office.

translations.idiomatic: From now on, whoever digs up or destroys tombs and mounds shall be beheaded.

sentences.zh: 」劉駿將殷孝祖修兩城於清水東，詔鎮西將軍天水公封敕文等擊之。

translations.literal: Liu Jun's general Yin Xiaozu was repairing two fortresses east of the Qingshui; an edict ordered General Who Guards the West, Duke of Tianshui Feng Jiaowen, and others to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jun's general Yin Xiaozu was repairing two fortresses east of the Qingshui; an edict ordered Feng Jiaowen, General Who Guards the West and Duke of Tianshui, and others to attack him.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，車駕次于車輪山，累石記行。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the imperial carriage halted at Mount Chelun; stones were piled to record the journey.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day the court halted at Mount Chelun and piled stones to record the journey.

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔征西將軍皮豹子等三將三萬騎助擊孝祖。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: an edict ordered General Who Conquers the West Pi Baozi and three other commanders with thirty thousand horsemen to assist in attacking Xiaozu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month an edict ordered General Who Conquers the West Pi Baozi and three other commanders with thirty thousand horsemen to assist in attacking Xiaozu.

sentences.zh: [2]車駕度漠，蠕蠕絕跡遠遁，其別部烏朱賀頹、庫世頹率眾來降。

translations.literal: [2] The imperial carriage crossed the desert; the Rouran vanished without trace and fled far away; their separate division Wuzhu Huitui and Kushi Tui led their hosts to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: [2] The court crossed the desert; the Rouran vanished without trace and fled far away; their separate division Wuzhu Huitui and Kushi Tui led their hosts to surrender.

sentences.zh: 十有二月，征東將軍、中山王託真薨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: General Who Conquers the East, Prince of Zhongshan Tuozhen, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Tuozhen, General Who Conquers the East and Prince of Zhongshan, died.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己巳朔，征西將軍皮豹子略地至高平，大破孝祖，斬獲五千餘級。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, day jisi first of month: General Who Conquers the West Pi Baozi raided as far as Gaoping, greatly defeated Xiaozu, and beheaded and captured more than five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of spring of the fifth year, the jisi day, General Who Conquers the West Pi Baozi raided as far as Gaoping, greatly defeated Xiaozu, and beheaded and captured more than five thousand.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，侍中、司空、河南公伊馛薨。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou: Palace Attendant, Minister of the Masses, Duke of Henan Yi Ba, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiyou day, Yi Ba, Palace Attendant, Minister of the Masses, and Duke of Henan, died.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，曲赦京師死罪已下。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: a partial amnesty in the capital for those below death in punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengyin day, there was a partial amnesty in the capital for those below death in punishment.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，封皇弟子推為京兆王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi: the imperial younger brother's son Tui was enfeoffed as Prince of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yisi day, the emperor's younger brother's son Tui was enfeoffed as Prince of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 五月，居常國遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: Fifth month: the state of Juchang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the state of Juchang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wushen: the imperial carriage traveled to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wushen day, the emperor went to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚戌，遂幸雲中。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day gengxu: then traveled to Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the gengxu day, he then went to Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，還宮。

translations.literal: Day renxu: returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，詔曰：「夫褒賞必於有功，刑罰審於有罪，此古今之所同，由來之常式。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuchen: an edict said: "Rewards must be for those with merit; punishments must be examined for those with guilt—this is the same through antiquity and the constant pattern from of old.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wuchen day, an edict said, "Rewards must go to those with merit; punishments must be examined for those with guilt—this is the same through antiquity and the constant pattern from of old.

sentences.zh: 牧守莅民，侵食百姓，以營家業，王賦不充，雖歲滿去職，應計前逋，正其刑罪。

translations.literal: Governors who face the people and devour the common people to build up their households, so that royal levies are not fulfilled—even when their term is full and they leave office, their prior arrears should be reckoned and their crimes and punishments corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Governors who face the people and devour the common people to build up their households, so that royal levies are not fulfilled—even when their term is full and they leave office, their prior arrears should be reckoned and their crimes corrected.

sentences.zh: 而主者失於督察，不加彈正，使有罪者優游獲免，無罪者妄受其辜，是啟姦邪之路，長貪暴之心，豈所謂原情處罪，以正天下。

translations.literal: Yet the responsible officials fail in oversight and do not impeach and correct, letting the guilty roam free in ease and the guiltless wrongly suffer their wrong—this opens the road of wickedness and depravity and lengthens the heart of greed and violence. Is this what is called weighing circumstances in imposing punishment to correct the realm?
translations.idiomatic: Yet the responsible officials fail in oversight and do not impeach and correct, letting the guilty roam free and the guiltless wrongly suffer—this opens the road of wickedness and lengthens greed and violence. Is this what is called weighing circumstances in imposing punishment to correct the realm?

sentences.zh: 自今諸遷代者，仰列在職殿最，案制治罪。

translations.literal: From now on, for all who transfer and replace office, they shall list their performance ratings while in office and, according to regulations, impose punishment.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, for all who transfer and leave office, they shall list their performance ratings while in office and, according to regulations, impose punishment.

sentences.zh: 克舉者加之爵寵，有愆者肆之刑戮，使能否殊貫，刑賞不差。

translations.literal: Those who achieve merit shall receive added rank and favor; those with faults shall be exposed to punishment and execution, so that ability and inability are clearly distinguished and punishment and reward do not err.
translations.idiomatic: Those who achieve merit shall receive added rank and favor; those with faults shall be exposed to punishment, so that ability and inability are clearly distinguished and punishment and reward do not err.

sentences.zh: 主者明為條制，以為常楷。

translations.literal: The responsible officials shall clearly make regulations and take them as a constant model."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials shall clearly make regulations and take them as a constant model."

sentences.zh: 」儀同三司敦煌公李寶薨。

translations.literal: Three-Director Equipage, Duke of Dunhuang Li Bao, died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bao, Three-Director Equipage and Duke of Dunhuang, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十有二月戊申，詔曰：「朕承洪業，統御羣有，思恢政化，以濟兆民。

translations.literal: Winter, twelfth month, day wushen: an edict said: "We have received the great enterprise and rule the host; We think to restore government and teaching to succor the myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on the wushen day, an edict said, "We have received the great enterprise and rule the host; we think to restore government and teaching to succor the myriad people.

sentences.zh: 故薄賦斂以實其財，輕徭役以紓其力，欲令百姓修業，人不匱乏。

translations.literal: Therefore We lighten levies and collections to fill their wealth and lighten corvée to ease their strength, wishing to let the common people cultivate their occupations so that people are not in want.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we lighten levies and collections to fill their wealth and lighten corvée to ease their strength, wishing to let the common people cultivate their occupations so that none are in want.

sentences.zh: 而六鎮、雲中、高平、二雍、秦州，徧遇災旱，年穀不收。

translations.literal: Yet the Six Garrisons, Yunzhong, Gaoping, the Two Yongs, and Qinzhou everywhere met disaster and drought, and the year's grain was not harvested.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Six Garrisons, Yunzhong, Gaoping, the Two Yongs, and Qinzhou everywhere met disaster and drought, and the year's grain was not harvested.

sentences.zh: 其遣開倉廩以賑之。

translations.literal: Let granaries and storehouses be opened to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Let granaries and storehouses be opened to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 有流徙者，諭還桑梓。

translations.literal: Those who have fled and wandered, instruct them to return to their native places.
translations.idiomatic: Those who have fled and wandered, instruct them to return to their native places.

sentences.zh: 欲市糴他界，為關傍郡，通其交易之路。

translations.literal: Those who wish to buy grain in other regions—make the neighboring commanderies at the passes open the roads of trade.
translations.idiomatic: Those who wish to buy grain in other regions—make the neighboring commanderies at the passes open the roads of trade.

sentences.zh: 若典司之官，分職不均，使上恩不達於下，下民不贍於時，加以重罪，無有攸縱。」

translations.literal: If the officials in charge do not divide duties evenly, so that the sovereign's favor does not reach below and the people below are not provided for in their time, add the heavy penalty—there shall be no escape."
translations.idiomatic: If the officials in charge do not divide duties evenly, so that the sovereign's favor does not reach below and the people below are not provided for in their time, add the heavy penalty—there shall be no escape."

sentences.zh: 和平元年春正月甲子朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: First year of Heping, spring, first month, day jiazi first of month: a general amnesty; the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of spring of the first year of Heping, the jiazi day, there was a general amnesty and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: [3]庚午，詔散騎常侍馮闡使於劉駿。

translations.literal: [3] Day gengwu: an edict ordered Palace Attendant Feng Kan as envoy to Liu Jun.
translations.idiomatic: [3] On the gengwu day an edict ordered Palace Attendant Feng Kan as envoy to Liu Jun.

sentences.zh: 二月，衞將軍、樂安王良督東雍、吐京、六壁諸軍西趣河西，征西將軍皮豹子等督河西諸軍南趨石樓，以討河西叛胡。

translations.literal: Second month: General of the Guard, Prince of Le'an Liang, supervised the armies of East Yong, Tujing, and Liubi west toward Hexi; General Who Conquers the West Pi Baozi and others supervised the Hexi armies south toward Shilou, to attack the rebel Hu of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month General of the Guard Liang, Prince of Le'an, supervised the armies of East Yong, Tujing, and Liubi west toward Hexi; Pi Baozi, General Who Conquers the West, and others supervised the Hexi armies south toward Shilou to attack the rebel Hu of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，皇太后常氏崩於壽安宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuxu: Empress Dowager Chang died at Shou'an Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuxu day, Empress Dowager Chang died at Shou'an Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，葬昭太后於廣寧鳴鷄山。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiyou: Empress Dowager Zhao was buried at Mingji Mountain in Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guiyou day, Empress Dowager Zhao was buried at Mingji Mountain in Guangning.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，詔征西大將軍、陽平王新成等督統萬、高平諸軍出南道，南郡公李惠等督涼州諸軍出北道，討吐谷渾什寅。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiawu: an edict ordered General Who Conquers the West, Prince of Yangping Xincheng, and others to supervise the armies of Tongwan and Gaoping and march by the southern route; Duke of Nanjun Li Hui and others to supervise the Liangzhou armies and march by the northern route, to attack Murong Shiyin of Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiawu day, an edict ordered Xincheng, General Who Conquers the West and Prince of Yangping, and others to supervise the armies of Tongwan and Gaoping and march by the southern route; Li Hui, Duke of Nanjun, and others to supervise the Liangzhou armies and march by the northern route to attack Murong Shiyin of Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 崔浩之誅也，史官遂廢，至是復置。

translations.literal: When Cui Hao was executed the historiographical office was abolished; at this time it was restored.
translations.idiomatic: When Cui Hao was executed the historiographical office was abolished; at this time it was restored.

sentences.zh: 河西叛胡詣長安首罪，遣使者安慰之。

translations.literal: The rebel Hu of Hexi came to Chang'an to confess guilt; envoys were sent to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel Hu of Hexi came to Chang'an to confess guilt; envoys were sent to comfort them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，劉駿遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yichou: Liu Jun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yichou day, Liu Jun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬午，行幸河西。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the imperial carriage traveled to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day the emperor went to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 八月，西征諸軍至西平，什寅走保南山。

translations.literal: Eighth month: the western expedition armies reached Xiping; Shiyin fled and held Mount Nanshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the western expedition armies reached Xiping; Shiyin fled and held Mount Nanshan.

sentences.zh: 九月，諸軍濟河追之，遇瘴氣，多有疫疾，乃引軍還；

translations.literal: Ninth month: the armies crossed the river in pursuit; they met miasma and many suffered epidemic illness, then led the army back;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the armies crossed the river in pursuit; they met miasma and many suffered epidemic illness, then led the army back;

sentences.zh: 獲畜二十餘萬。

translations.literal: livestock captured were more than two hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: they captured more than two hundred thousand head of livestock.

sentences.zh: 庚午，輿駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，居常王獻馴象三。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: the king of Juchang presented three trained elephants.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the king of Juchang presented three trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，詔散騎侍郎盧度世、員外郎朱安興使於劉駿。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: an edict ordered Palace Attendant Lu Dushi and Outer Office Member Zhu Anxing as envoys to Liu Jun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month an edict ordered Palace Attendant Lu Dushi and Outer Office Member Zhu Anxing as envoys to Liu Jun.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙酉，詔曰：「刺史牧民，為萬里之表。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day yiyou: an edict said: "The provincial governor shepherds the people and is the model for ten thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the yiyou day, an edict said, "The provincial governor shepherds the people and is the model for ten thousand li.

sentences.zh: 自頃每因發調，逼民假貸，大商富賈，要射時利，旬日之間，增贏十倍。

translations.literal: Recently, whenever levies were issued, the people were forced to borrow on loan; great merchants and rich traders speculated on the season's profit, and within ten days profit increased tenfold.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, whenever levies were issued, the people were forced to borrow; great merchants and rich traders speculated on seasonal profit, and within ten days profit increased tenfold.

sentences.zh: 上下通同，分以潤屋。

translations.literal: High and low connived together and divided the gain to enrich their houses.
translations.idiomatic: High and low connived together and divided the gain to enrich their houses.

sentences.zh: 故編戶之家，困於凍餒；

translations.literal: Therefore registered households' families are distressed by cold and hunger;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore registered households are distressed by cold and hunger;

sentences.zh: 豪富之門，日有兼積。

translations.literal: the doors of the powerful and rich daily accumulate doubly.
translations.idiomatic: the doors of the powerful and rich daily grow doubly richer.

sentences.zh: 為政之弊，莫過於此。

translations.literal: Among the defects of government, nothing surpasses this.
translations.idiomatic: Among the defects of government, nothing surpasses this.

sentences.zh: 其一切禁絕，犯者十疋以上皆死。

translations.literal: Let it all be utterly forbidden; violators above ten bolts of cloth all die.
translations.idiomatic: Let it all be utterly forbidden; violators dealing in ten bolts of cloth or more shall die.

sentences.zh: 布告天下，咸令知禁。

translations.literal: Proclaim throughout the realm and let all know the prohibition."
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim throughout the realm and let all know the prohibition."

translations.literal: " Second month, day xinmao: the imperial carriage traveled to Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the xinmao day, the emperor went to Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，至于鄴，遂幸信都。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: reached Ye, then traveled to Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day he reached Ye, then went to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月，劉駿遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Third month: Liu Jun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Liu Jun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 輿駕所過，皆親對高年，問民疾苦。

translations.literal: Wherever the imperial carriage passed, he personally received the aged and inquired after the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever the court passed, he personally received the aged and inquired after the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 詔民年八十以上，一子不從役。

translations.literal: An edict: for people eighty and above, one son was exempt from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that for people eighty and above, one son was exempt from corvée.

sentences.zh: 靈丘南有山，高四百餘丈。

translations.literal: South of Lingqiu there is a mountain more than four hundred zhang high.
translations.idiomatic: South of Lingqiu there is a mountain more than four hundred zhang high.

sentences.zh: 乃詔羣官仰射山峯，無能踰者。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the assembled officials to shoot upward at the mountain peak; none could surpass it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the assembled officials to shoot upward at the mountain peak; none could surpass it.

sentences.zh: 帝彎弧發矢，出山三十餘丈，過山南二百二十步，遂刊石勒銘。

translations.literal: The Emperor drew the bow and released an arrow; it went out from the mountain more than thirty zhang, passed south of the mountain two hundred twenty paces, and stone was carved with an inscription.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor drew the bow and released an arrow; it went beyond the peak more than thirty zhang, passed south of the mountain two hundred twenty paces, and stone was carved with an inscription.

sentences.zh: 是月，發并、肆州五千人治河西獵道。

translations.literal: That month five thousand men from Bing and Si provinces were sent to work on the hunting road in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: That month five thousand men from Bing and Si provinces were sent to work on the hunting road in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，輿駕還宮。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，侍中、征東大將軍、河東王閭毗薨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiwei: Palace Attendant, General Who Conquers the East, Prince of Hedong Lu Pi, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yiwei day, Lu Pi, Palace Attendant, General Who Conquers the East, and Prince of Hedong, died.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，詔南部尚書黃盧頭、李敷等考課諸州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiwei: an edict ordered Minister of the South Huang Lutou and Li Fu and others to examine and grade the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guiwei day, an edict ordered Minister of the South Huang Lutou and Li Fu and others to examine and grade the provinces.

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuyin: the imperial younger brother Xiaoxincheng was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiyin, with added General Who Conquers the East, garrisoning Pingyuan;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wuyin day, the emperor's younger brother Xiaoxincheng was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiyin, with added General Who Conquers the East, garrisoning Pingyuan;

translations.literal: Tiansi as Prince of Runan, with added General Who Conquers the South, garrisoning Hulao;
translations.idiomatic: Tiansi as Prince of Runan, with added General Who Conquers the South, garrisoning Hulao;

translations.literal: Wanshou as Prince of Lelang, with added General Who Conquers the North, garrisoning Helong;
translations.idiomatic: Wanshou as Prince of Lelang, with added General Who Conquers the North, garrisoning Helong;

sentences.zh: 洛侯為廣平王。

translations.literal: Luohou as Prince of Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: Luohou as Prince of Guangping.

sentences.zh: 壬午，行巡山北。

translations.literal: Day renwu: traveled north of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day he traveled north of the mountains.

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuchen: the state of Persia sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuchen day, the state of Persia sent envoys with tribute.

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter an edict made Acting Outer Palace Attendant You Minggen and He Tiande, Outer Office Member and Marquis of Changyi, envoys to Liu Jun.

translations.literal: In Shenze of Boling and Dongzhou of Zhangwu, bandits killed the county magistrate; provincial armies suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In Shenze of Boling and Dongzhou of Zhangwu, bandits killed the county magistrate; provincial armies suppressed and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 廣平王洛侯薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Guangping Luohou died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Guangping Luohou died.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬午，以車騎大將軍、東郡公乙渾為太原王。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day renwu: General of Chariots and Cavalry, Duke of Dongjun Yi Hun, was made Prince of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the renwu day, Yi Hun, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Duke of Dongjun, was made Prince of Taiyuan.
